derivation:
by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite α
  simpa only [Subtype.ext_iff] using (isoCycle (α := α)).symm.bijective.existsUnique ⟨f, hf⟩
explanation: The inverse of isoCycle sends a nontrivial nodup cycle to its formPerm. Its bijectivity gives the required unique preimage of ⟨f, hf⟩. This equivalence is constructed independently before the target theorem.
